purpose: Turn Elementor JSON source evidence into reproducible WordPress/Elementor runtime evidence with widget inventory, render checks and responsive screenshots.

required_when: new or screenshot-reconstructed Elementor JSON needs a runtime or visual claim
existing Elementor JSON changes structure, widgets, widget settings, responsive behavior or dependencies
the user asks to test, scan, render, preview, screenshot, verify widgets, verify Pro or check import behavior
source-valid JSON is about to be described as runtime-valid or visually correct
optional_when: the task is a source-only audit or planning task and no runtime or visual claim is needed
forbidden_when: input contains secrets, credentials, personal data or client-confidential content while this repository is public
the task requires exact target-site IDs or target compatibility without target inventory or staging evidence
the task is a production or live-site mutation

why: detect missing or unavailable Elementor widgets before target import
check the JSON against widgets and controls registered by a real Elementor runtime
prove that WordPress and Elementor can render the supplied template in a disposable environment
produce desktop, tablet and mobile screenshots for visual iteration
separate source-only confidence from controlled-runtime evidence

inputs.target_inventory: target/inventory.json (optional; exported from a controlled target installation)
inputs.elementor_pro_secret: ELEMENTOR_PRO_LICENSE_KEY (optional GitHub Actions secret; never commit the value)
inputs.reference_visual: kept outside this public repository when confidential; used by the calling assistant for comparison

pipeline: install and activate Elementor Core and Hello Elementor
optionally install and activate Elementor Pro from Elementor's official Composer repository
export the registered Elementor widget and control inventory
audit every template against the runtime and optional target inventory
render every valid template into an isolated Elementor Canvas page
capture desktop, tablet and mobile screenshots with Playwright
upload audit reports, runtime inventory, render manifests, Pro status and screenshots as workflow artifacts
deactivate the temporary Pro license when used and destroy the runtime

can_support: runtime widget availability in the disposable environment
responsive screenshot review at the configured viewports
does_not_prove: site-specific object IDs or dynamic data

iteration.on_failure: Repair only confirmed JSON, dependency or render defects; never invent unknown Atomic, Pro, add-on or site-object data; then rerun the same pipeline.
iteration.on_visual_mismatch: Adjust the canonical JSON, rerun, compare the new screenshots and repeat until the requested visual acceptance is met.
iteration.formal_final_gate: When Project Elementor requires a formal cleanup, import, release or 10/10 claim, require two identical green final rounds before handoff to staging/QA.

privacy.rule: Do not commit confidential client JSON, private screenshots, credentials, license keys, personal data or secret URLs. Use a private runtime/repository or sanitized fixtures instead.
privacy.secret_handling: ELEMENTOR_PRO_LICENSE_KEY must exist only as a GitHub Actions secret and must never be logged or committed.
